Notice that the function $p(x)$ is differentiable for all $x>0.$ Therefore, the correct answer is $p(x)=\sqrt{x}.$

Other functions are not differentiable at $x=3.$

- The function $f(x)$ is not defined at $x=3$, so it is not differentiable there.

- The function $g(x)$ has a corner point at $x=3$, so it is not differentiable there.

- The function $h(x)$ has a vertical tangent at  $x=3$, so it is not differentiable there.

- The function $q(x)$ has a jump discontinuity at $x=3$, so it is not differentiable there.
